mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, org_code, org_name, sort_no, status FROM sys_org WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no, id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.org_id, o.org_name, u.avatar_object_key, u.status FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id
